fields.meta_description: Build a proposal form that opens follow-up questions on a yes and sends each signed proposal to the person who decides. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Proposal Form That Ends in a Clear Yes or No
fields.hero_description: Create a proposal form that takes signatures, routes each proposal to its approvers in order, and saves it to your own database.
fields.features_heading: Proposal Forms That Reach a Decision
fields.features_subheading: A carbonless proposal book records what someone asked for. These six parts carry the request to the person who answers it.
fields.feature_1:
Follow-up questions only when they apply

Ask the short version first and open the detail on a yes. A past claim, a second approver or a cost over budget each brings its own questions, and nobody scrolls past blank ones.
fields.feature_2:
Signatures and initials on any clause

Capture a signature at the end and initials beside the clauses that matter. Each signed proposal is stored with its date and the exact wording of the terms the proposer agreed to.
fields.feature_3:
Approvals in the order you set

Send each proposal to the people who decide, one after another or by amount. Every approver sees the earlier decisions, and the proposer gets an email once the last one rules.
fields.feature_4:
Figures worked out on the form

Calculate totals, payback periods, or credit hours from the answers as they are typed. Each reviewer opens a proposal with that figure at the top instead of a calculator beside it.
fields.feature_5:
Attachments kept with the proposal

Accept drawings and photos as uploads on the same form, along with budget sheets. Every file stays attached to its proposal record instead of sitting in one person's inbox.
fields.feature_6:
Every proposal in your own repository

Export the full code to your GitHub on paid plans whenever you choose. Each proposal and its approvals sit in a database you own, and developers build on it like any codebase.
fields.why_title: Why Build Proposal Forms With Emergent?
fields.why_description: A Word or PDF template records the proposal. It cannot ask a follow-up, add up the cost or tell an approver one is waiting.

fields.tab_content_1:
Every past loss declared with its cost

Calder Insurance Brokers asks each shop owner about losses in the last 5 years. A yes opens three more questions: date, cause, and amount paid. Ellen Marsh of Millstone Bakery declared a $6,400 water damage claim from March 2024. Her account executive saw the full answer before the insurer did.
fields.tab_content_2:
Initialed, signed, and scheduled from her phone

Brightline Roofing sends each homeowner a proposal to read on a phone: a 28-square tear-off with new underlayment for $14,600. A clause pricing rotted decking at $95 a sheet needs her initials. Priya Nair initialed it and signed. The job moved to the crew schedule that afternoon.
fields.tab_content_3:
Approved by the sponsor, now with the department head

Mara Lindqvist is proposing a three-credit independent study in soil microbiology at Ridgeline University, at 9 hours a week. Dr. Owen Hale approved it as her sponsor. Every independent study also needs the department head. The form passed it to Dr. Ruth Adeyemi with the sponsor's approval shown first.
fields.tab_content_4:
Paid back in 8 months, sent to the CFO

Line lead Sam Ortiz at Globex Packaging proposed a $38,000 conveyor upgrade expected to save $57,000 a year. The form put the payback at 8 months. Plant managers approve up to $25,000, and anything above goes to the CFO. CFO Dana Whitfield opened it with the payback figure on top.

fields.howto_title: How to Make a Proposal Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to plan a proposal form around the person who approves it, then test it before the first one goes out.
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Set the figures the form calculates
fields.howto_step_1_des: Name the people who approve a proposal and the order they go in. An insurer looks for risk details, a homeowner for price and scope, and a budget holder for cost against the savings.
fields.howto_step_2_des: List every question the approver asks before agreeing, and turn each into a field. Drop anything nobody reads. Where a yes needs detail, mark it as a follow-up instead of a field every proposer has to skip.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write down any number the approver works out by hand today: a total, a payback period, a credit load. Give the formula in plain words. The proposer sees the result before sending and can correct a wrong input there.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Copy the questions from your current proposal form PDF or Word file into the prompt, then add the approval order and the formulas. Emergent builds the form with its approval steps, plus a database row for every proposal.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Mark which clauses need initials and where the signature goes. Keep the terms on the same screen as the signature line, and store the wording with each signed proposal in case the terms change next season.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Decide what the proposer hears at each step: a receipt on submit, an email when an approver decides and a reminder if a proposal sits unanswered for two days. Approvers get a Slack or email alert with the proposal attached.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Submit one as the proposer would
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill the form on a phone with real answers, including a yes that opens follow-ups and an amount over the approval limit. Check that each approver receives it in order. Delete the test proposal before you share the link.

plan.angle: The live results for proposal form are printed carbonless books, Word and PDF templates, a stock photo page and an insurance proposal PDF, and seven of the nine People Also Ask questions are about insurance. Every result is a blank page for the person proposing. None handles the other side: the decision. claims_to_source: An insurance proposal form is filled in by the prospect to give the insurer the information, including material information, it needs to decide whether to underwrite the risk and, if it accepts, on what rates and terms

Under the duty of utmost good faith, an insurer can cancel a health policy when the policyholder misrepresented or did not disclose a material fact, and material facts are the information the insurer asks for in the proposal form

Health insurance proposal forms ask whether each person to be insured is in good health and for details of any illness, may require a pre-acceptance health checkup after an adverse medical history, end with a declaration the proposer signs, and insurers publish their own proposal forms for their products
The signed proposal form is the record of the proposer's statements and the basis of the insurance contract

scope.evidence: H1 'Build a Proposal Form That Ends in a Clear Yes or No' and meta title 'Proposal Form Builder With Sign-Off and Routing | Emergent' state the whole job. Hero 'Create a proposal form that takes signatures, routes each proposal to its approvers in order, and saves it to your own database.' is under 130 chars, carries the primary, leads with a verb (D1). How-to description is one sentence under 140 chars (D2). CTA 'Build My Proposal Form' (D3).

intent.evidence: SERP of carbonless books, templates and insurance explainers with seven insurance PAA questions: the page answers the insurance questions (FAQ 4-8), the template ask (FAQ 9), the pdf secondary (FAQ 10, how-to 4) and shows four proposal types through to a decision.

specificity.evidence: Buyer vocabulary per segment: 'a 28-square tear-off with new underlayment', 'rotted decking at $95 a sheet', 'a three-credit independent study', 'Plant managers approve up to $25,000'.

openers.evidence: Paragraphs open on full sentences: 'Calder Insurance Brokers asks each shop owner about losses in the last 5 years', 'Brightline Roofing sends each homeowner a proposal', 'Name the people who approve a proposal and the order they go in'.

craft.evidence: No blocking craft defect; three lists without the serial comma are recorded as notes.

voice.evidence: Concrete detail: 'a $6,400 water damage claim from March 2024', 'The job moved to the crew schedule that afternoon', 'Delete the test proposal before you share the link'.

truth.evidence: FAQ 5 attributes the material-information rule to 'Indian insurance regulations', which the cited Law Insider page does not say (its definitions come from insurer policy wordings and RFPs, none naming a regulation). FAQ 7 states 'Standard health policy terms let an insurer void the policy over a material fact that was misrepresented or left out'; the cited Manipal Cigna page grounds voiding in the utmost-good-faith principle and names no standard policy terms. The rest matches its sources and claims_used; tab 4 payback 38,000 / 57,000 x 12 = 8 months agrees between copy and image.

distinct.evidence: Price-only requests handed to the quote form sibling (FAQ 3) and vendor solicitations to the RFP form sibling (FAQ 10); no sibling primary in any heading.

faq.evidence: Exactly 10 questions, eight from PAA, none naming a brand (PA14) or a file format or download (PA15); hub link in item 2; links to quote form and RFP form; moat lines in items 9 and 10 (F9). Each answer opens on its answer.

images.evidence: Contact sheet: one hero per tab, readable. Tab 1 '3 follow-up questions opened', 'Amount paid $6,400', 'March 2024', Millstone Bakery; tab 2 '28 squares', '$14,600', '$95 a sheet', 'Initialed: PN', 'Job moved to the crew schedule'; tab 3 sponsor approved, Dr. Ruth Adeyemi in review, '3 credits', '9 hours a week'; tab 4 '$38,000', 'Saves $57,000 a year', 'Payback 8 months', 'Sent to Dana Whitfield'. Cover repeats $38,000 and 8 months.

findings.quote: Indian insurance regulations treat those answers as the material information the insurer weighs before taking on the risk.
findings.issue: A statement of law (what a national regulation provides) whose only source, the Law Insider dictionary page, does not say it: its definitions are taken from insurer policy wordings and RFP documents and none names a regulation. The domain_sources claim does not mention a regulation either (FAQ 5).
findings.fix: Either source the regulation itself (the IRDAI regulation that defines 'proposal form') in domain_sources and keep the sentence, or drop the attribution: 'The insurer treats those answers as the material information it weighs before taking on the risk.'

findings.quote: Standard health policy terms let an insurer void the policy over a material fact that was misrepresented or left out.
findings.issue: A statement about standard policy terms that the cited source does not make: the Manipal Cigna page grounds cancellation in the utmost-good-faith principle and names no standard clause. The sentence also names no jurisdiction on a US page, where the rule does not hold the same way (FAQ 7).
findings.fix: Say what the source says, with its scope: 'Under the duty of utmost good faith, an insurer can cancel the policy when a material fact was misrepresented or left out.' Name the jurisdiction if a source for it is added.
